items.titleEn: Bieber, Blue Jays persist through rash of injuries to steal another series win
bodyEn: ST PETERSBURG -- The Blue Jays are making the best of what they have right now.

What they have on the field seems to change from game to game due to injuries -- and it did again on Thursday. But, undaunted, Toronto knocked off the first-place Rays at Tropicana Field by the score of 5-1 to notch its seventh consecutive series win. It was also the club’s first series win inside the Trop since Sept. 2023.
At 63-66, the Blue Jays are a half game behind the Twins for the third American League Wild Card spot. Toronto is tied in the standings with the Rangers, who play Thursday night.

That will make for a pretty happy flight to New York before Toronto opens a three-game weekend series at Yankee Stadium. But the Blue Jays will fly north wondering what exactly their lineup will look like when the series begins Friday night.

Shortstop Andrés Giménez left the game in the fourth inning after injuring his right leg while running out a ground ball. The team announced that the three-time Gold Glover is dealing with right hamstring tightness.

That forced the Blue Jays to make a full line change on their infield for the fifth inning. Because of injuries to Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (concussion) and Josh Smith (leg cramp), Toronto had Ernie Clement move from second base to shortstop to fill in for Giménez. Charles McAdoo went from third to second, Kazuma Okamoto moved from first to third, and backup catcher Brandon Valenzuela entered at first base.

This is what the Blue Jays are dealing with right now. Not to mention that they also saw outfielder Brett Bateman exit Tuesday’s loss with right hamstring tightness as well. Through it all, Toronto keeps finding ways to win.

Shane Bieber turned in arguably his best start of the season, dealing seven innings of one-run ball. He allowed four hits and struck out seven batters without issuing a walk. He threw a season-high 101 pitches, 70 for strikes.

The Blue Jays backed him with three more homers, giving them seven over the three-game series. Prior to arriving in St. Petersburg, the power-starved Blue Jays had hit just six homers in their previous 11 games.

Kazuma Okamoto got the scoring start with his second homer of the series, a projected 414-foot solo shot to left field. Outfielders Nathan Lukes and Daz Cameron added solo homers in the fifth inning. Cameron’s clout down the left-field line traveled 442 feet and never actually came down; it landed on one of Tropicana Field’s catwalks.
Lukes also made a phenomenal leaping catch at the wall to rob Cedric Mullins of extra bases and a possible RBI in the seventh inning.
items.author: Brian Murphy

items.titleEn: Sánchez holds himself accountable for LF mistakes; Vladdy to begin rehab games
bodyEn: ST. PETERSBURG -- Jesús Sánchez sat at his locker inside Tropicana Field on Thursday morning and took full accountability for his two outfield mistakes that proved very costly in the Blue Jays’ 7-6 loss to the Rays the night before.

There was the high fly ball that evaded his glove in the first inning. There was the low, soft liner that he lost in the fourth inning. Both miscues contributed directly or indirectly to all of Tampa Bay’s seven runs.
“No excuses,” Sánchez said. “That's the two balls that I need to make the catch [on], and I [missed] it. Something happened.”
OK, so what exactly happened?

On the first play, Sánchez said that Junior Caminero’s fly ball down the left-field line flew over one of the stadium’s catwalks, and Sánchez briefly lost sight of the ball. From there, he had trouble finding the ball against the Trop’s white roof. It ultimately landed away from his outstretched glove and bounced over the short wall for a ground-rule double.
“That’s going to be difficult and everything, so the only thing I need to do is go through and catch the ball,” Sánchez said.
On Richie Palacios’ fly ball into shallow left field, Sánchez said he initially saw the ball coming at him. Then the lights got into his eyes.

“When I made the first step, the light [got] into my eyes, and I just looked at [shortstop Andrés Giménez] … because I knew I was losing the ball,” Sánchez said. “That's a ball [that’s] easy to catch, and I missed [trying] to catch it.”

Manager John Schneider was supportive of the left fielder because he knows how much he works on being a better defensive player. And Sánchez was adamant that he is putting in the work to get a better first step to fly balls and take better angles while playing in left field, which is not as familiar to him as right field.
“I'm working hard on my defense to improve and get better,” he said. “And I know I'm going to get better.”
Vlad Jr. to play in rehab game
It appears more and more like Vladimir Guerrero Jr. will be activated from the seven-day concussion injured list when he is first eligible ahead of Saturday’s game against the Yankees.

But before Guerrero plays in the Bronx, he is going to play in Clearwater, Fla. Manager John Schneider said Thursday that Guerrero has been cleared to play in a Minor League game, and he will be the designated hitter for Single-A Dunedin in its game tonight versus the Clearwater Threshers, the Phillies’ Single-A affiliate. It will be Guerrero’s first game action since he suffered a concussion following a collision with Yankees infielder George Lombard Jr. on Aug. 14 at Rogers Centre.
“See how it goes today, and hopefully Saturday, he can be back with us,” Schneider said.
items.author: Brian Murphy

items.titleEn: Perry enjoying one of Minors' biggest breakouts in 2026
bodyEn: MLB Pipeline gave a full refresh to its Top 100 Prospects list last week -- and each team’s Top 30 -- now that the 2026 draftees have joined their respective organizations. That makes it as good a time as any to look at the biggest breakout players in Minor Leagues.

Some of these players were high Draft picks or on the preseason Top 100 Prospects list. Others came out of relative obscurity. What they all have in common is that they've answered major questions about their profiles.

We're not strictly looking at the highest risers in the rankings -- Padres top prospect Ethan Salas went from unranked to No. 23 but had more of a "bounceback" campaign than a "breakout" season, for example. These players are at their peak value to date and have up arrows next to their names.
Here's a look at 10 of the biggest breakouts, in alphabetical order.
Franklin Arias, SS, Red Sox (BOS No. 1/MLB No. 3)Preseason ranking: BOS No. 2/MLB No. 31

Arias ranked highly to start the year because of his precocious bat-to-ball skills and glove, but his big step forward in power has enabled him to become one of the very best prospects in the game. He already has more home runs this season (23) than he hit in his first three seasons combined (18) and ranks in the 81st percentile at Triple-A with a 44.3 percent hard-hit rate. The 20-year-old rarely whiffs and has a chance to be the youngest Red Sox player to make his big league debut since Rafael Devers in 2017.
Anthony Eyanson, RHP, Orioles (BAL No. 2/MLB No. 49)Preseason ranking: BOS No. 10

Eyanson was the third Southeastern Conference hurler the Red Sox drafted last year, but he quickly emerged as their best selection before Boston shipped him to Baltimore in the Adley Rutschman trade. The 6-foot-1 righty has seen a big uptick in stuff, including two ticks of velocity on his fastball (topping out at 100 mph) and the development of a promising splitter after barely using a changeup in college. The Louisiana State product's athleticism gives hope that he'll develop above-average command to complement his impressive feel for spin.
Theo Gillen, OF, Rays (TB No. 2/MLB No. 12)Preseason ranking: TB No. 1/MLB No. 76

Gillen had battled injuries for years -- a torn labrum and knee injury in high school and calf and wrist maladies in pro ball -- that held him back as he emerged as potentially the top high school bat in the 2023 Draft. The Texas native is finally healthy this season, and not only is he continuing to display tremendous bat-to-ball skills and a discerning eye, but he's also emerged as a power hitter. The 20-year-old has put together a 20/40 season between High-A and Double-A -- converting nearly a third of his fly balls into homers -- while playing quality defense in center field.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
Eric Hartman, OF, Braves (ATL No. 1/MLB No. 42)Preseason ranking: ATL No. 20

The Braves went over slot in the 20th round of the 2024 Draft to sign Hartman for $340,000 as a speedy Canadian outfielder. Two years into his pro career, his raw tools are translating into big-time production. He crushed 24 homers in 93 High-A games before earning a promotion to Double-A. Sure enough, with 47 steals to boot, he became the fastest Minor Leaguer to reach the 20/30 threshold (71 games) since Charlton Jimerson in 2007 (70 games).
Josiah Hartshorn, OF/1B, Cubs (CHC No. 1/MLB No. 39)Preseason ranking: CHC No. 8

Hartshorn got early second-round money as a 2025 sixth-rounder after showing some of the best power in his class. He's a switch-hitter, but an elbow injury limited him to essentially only hitting right-handed his first three years of high school before a back injury forced him to change to the other side of the plate. Finally able to use both swings, the California native became the first prep player in his Draft to reach High-A, and he's been fulfilling his power potential while nearly walking (70) as much as he's struck out (87).
Marek Houston, SS, Twins (MIN No. 4/MLB No. 74)Preseason ranking: MIN No. 8

Houston went 16th overall in the 2025 Draft as a no-doubt shortstop with a contact-oriented approach. He was not overly impressive in 24 games after signing but has displayed far more offensive aptitude than expected in his first full pro season. After adding muscle and improving his swing path, the Wake Forest product is barreling the ball more consistently. He doesn't have to hit much to be an everyday player, but the added impact and impressive speed raise the ceiling on this high-floor player.
Caden Hunter, LHP, Orioles (BAL No. 4/MLB No. 98)Preseason ranking: Not ranked

The 10th player the Orioles selected in the 2025 Draft, Hunter has taken a big leap forward thanks to an uptick in stuff. The southpaw is throwing harder than he did at Southern California, now touching 98 mph on his fastball, and his harder slider has emerged as an above-average pitch. The 22-year-old is also mixing in a curveball this season, helping him strike out batters at a 36.5 percent clip, which is third among Minor Leaguers with at least 80 innings.
Emil Morales, SS, Dodgers (LAD No. 4/MLB No. 24)Preseason ranking: LAD No. 5/MLB No. 92

Scouts projected Morales to have above-average hit and power tools when he signed for nearly $1.9 million as one of the top prospects in the 2024 international class, but he's taken his power to a new level in 2026 and is tied for second among teenage Minor Leaguers with 23 homers. The right-handed hitter has absolutely crushed fastballs -- his slash line is .348/.466/.690 -- while still hitting for enough power against secondary pitches (.174 ISO). He's quite physical at 6-foot-3 but has a chance to stick at shortstop thanks to promising instincts and arm strength.
Nolan Perry, RHP, Blue Jays (TOR No. 2/MLB No. 96)Preseason ranking: Not ranked

Perry was an intriguing high school arm out of the New Mexico high school ranks, but a torn UCL in 2024 paused his development. The 6-foot-2 right-hander has returned this season looking like a much-improved version of himself, adding two ticks of velocity that have made his entire arsenal more effective. Perry's walk rates have ticked up as better competition hasn't chased as much against him, but the 22-year-old's easy mechanics portend average long-term control, which should be more than enough to start, considering his impressive stuff.
Christian Zazueta, RHP, Dodgers (LAD No. 5/MLB No. 36)Preseason ranking: LAD No. 10

The Dodgers have a habit of picking up interesting prospects in trades and watching them take off in their impressive player development program, and Zazueta is their latest success. Acquired from the Yankees in the Caleb Ferguson trade, the 6-foot-3 righty uses his athleticism well to get elite extension, which helps his upper-90s fastball with carry play up. The 22-year-old has improved his strikeout and walk rates, leading to a 31.5 percent K/BB rate that ranks second among Minor League pitchers with at least 80 innings.
items.titleZh: Perry成为2026年小联盟最亮眼的新星之一
items.summaryZh: Perry迎来爆发，跻身小联盟顶级新秀。
bodyZh: MLB Pipeline上周全面更新了百大新秀榜单，以及各队的三十大新秀名单，因为2026年选秀球员已正式加入所属球队。现在正是回顾小联盟最亮眼突破球员的好时机。
这些球员中有些是选秀高顺位或季前百大新秀，另一些人则相对默默无闻。他们的共同点是，都解答了关于自身前景的重大疑问。
我们并非严格关注排名上升最多的球员——例如教士队头号新秀Ethan Salas从未上榜升至第23位，但他的赛季更像是一种“反弹”，而非“突破”。这些球员目前正处于价值顶峰，并且前景看涨。
以下按字母顺序介绍10位最耀眼的突破球员。
Franklin Arias，游击手，红袜队（BOS第1位/MLB第3位）季前排名：BOS第2位/MLB第31位
Arias开季排名很高，得益于他早熟的击球技术和手套，但他在力量上的大幅进步使他成为棒球界最顶尖的新秀之一。他本赛季的本垒打数（23支）已经超过此前三个赛季的总和（18支），在3A的强击球率高达44.3%，位列第81百分位。这位20岁小将很少挥空，有机会成为自2017年Rafael Devers以来红袜队最年轻的大联盟首秀球员。
Anthony Eyanson，右投手，金莺队（BAL第2位/MLB第49位）季前排名：BOS第10位
Eyanson是红袜去年选中的第三位东南联盟投手，但他很快成为红袜的最佳选择，随后波士顿将他交易至巴尔的摩以换取Adley Rutschman。这位6英尺1英寸的右投手球威大幅提升，包括快速球速度增加两英里（最快100英里/小时），并在大学时代几乎不用变速球的情况下开发出了有前途的指叉球。这位路易斯安那州立大学出身的球员，运动能力令人期待他能练出平均以上的控球，以配合他出色的旋转球手感。
Theo Gillen，外野手，光芒队（TB第2位/MLB第12位）季前排名：TB第1位/MLB第76位
Gillen多年来一直与伤病作斗争——高中时肩关节盂唇撕裂和膝盖受伤，职业棒球期间又遭遇小腿和手腕问题——这些伤病阻碍了他在2023年选秀中成为可能最好的高中打者的前景。这位得克萨斯州本地人本赛季终于恢复健康，不仅继续展现出惊人的击球技术和敏锐的选球，还成为了一名力量型打者。这位20岁小将在高A和2A之间打出了20/40赛季——将近三分之一的飞球转化成了本垒打——同时在中外野贡献了优质防守。
订阅MLB Pipeline通讯
Eric Hartman，外野手，勇士队（ATL第1位/MLB第42位）季前排名：ATL第20位
勇士队在2024年选秀第20轮溢价签下了Hartman，以34万美元签下这位速度出色的加拿大外野手。进入职业生涯两年，他的原始天赋已转化为亮眼的产量。他在高A的93场比赛中轰出24支本垒打，随后升上2A。果然，他还跑出47次盗垒，成为自2007年Charlton Jimerson（70场）以来最快达成20/30门槛（71场）的小联盟球员。
Josiah Hartshorn，外野手/一垒手，小熊队（CHC第1位/MLB第39位）季前排名：CHC第8位
Hartshorn在2025年选秀第6轮获得早期二轮签的签约金额，因为他展现出同届中顶级的打击力量。他是一名左右开弓的打者，但肘伤使他在高中前三年几乎只能用右打，后来背部受伤又迫使他换到另一侧打击。终于能够使用两边的打击后，这位加利福尼亚州本地人成为他这届选秀中第一位升上高A的高中球员，同时他也兑现了力量潜力，保送数（70次）几乎与三振数（87次）持平。
Marek Houston，游击手，双城队（MIN第4位/MLB第74位）季前排名：MIN第8位
Houston在2025年选秀首轮第16顺位被选中，是一名毫无疑问的游击手，打击风格以接触为主。他在签约后的24场比赛中并不特别亮眼，但在第一个完整职业赛季中展现出的进攻能力远超预期。在增肌和改善挥棒轨迹后，这位维克森林大学出身的球员击球更为扎实。他无需太多打击就能成为日常先发，但额外的打击威力和出色的速度提升了这位高下限球员的天花板。
Caden Hunter，左投手，金莺队（BAL第4位/MLB第98位）季前排名：未上榜
Hunter是金莺在2025年选秀中第10位选中的球员，凭借球威的提升实现了巨大飞跃。这位左投手比在南加州大学时投得更快，快速球现在能触及98英里/小时，他的滑球也变得更具威力，成为高于平均水平的球种。这位22岁选手本赛季还加入了曲球，帮助他以36.5%的三振率领跑小联盟（至少投满80局的球员中排名第三）。
Emil Morales，游击手，道奇队（LAD第4位/MLB第24位）季前排名：LAD第5位/MLB第92位

球探在Morales以近190万美元签约时，预期他拥有高于平均的打击和力量工具，作为2024年国际班中顶尖新秀之一，但他在2026年将力量提升到了新高度，以23支本垒打并列青少年小联盟球员中的第二位。这位右打者面对快速球时表现凶猛——打击三围为.348/.466/.690——同时仍能对次要球种打出足够的力量（ISO .174）。他身高6英尺3英寸，体格强壮，但由于出色的直觉和臂力，他有机会继续守游击。
Nolan Perry，右投手，蓝鸟队（TOR第2位/MLB第96位）季前排名：未上榜
Perry是一位来自新墨西哥州高中棒球界的引人注目的投手新秀，但2024年的尺骨副韧带撕裂让他的发展暂停。这位6英尺2英寸的右投手本赛季回归，看起来像是全面升级版的自己，增加了两英里/小时的球速，使他的整套球路更加有效。Perry的保送率有所上升，因为面对更强的打者，他们不太会追打他的球，但这位22岁选手轻松的投球动作预示着长期平均水平的控球，这应该足以胜任先发，考虑到他出色的球威。
Christian Zazueta，右投手，道奇队（LAD第5位/MLB第36位）季前排名：LAD第10位
道奇队习惯于在交易中拾取有趣的潜力新秀，然后看着他们在出色的球员培养体系中飞速成长，Zazueta就是最新的成功案例。这位6英尺3英寸的右投手是从洋基队通过Caleb Ferguson交易获得的，他善于利用运动能力获得精英级的出手延伸，这有助于他超过96英里/小时的快速球上飘效果。这位22岁选手提升了三振率和保送率，31.5%的三振保送比在小联盟所有至少投满80局的投手中排名第二。

bodyEn: All season long, baseball fans can watch Minor League Baseball games for free on the Bally Sports Live app or at BallySports.com. Fans may also purchase an MLB+ subscription, which includes access to MiLB games live and on demand, live MLB audio for all 30 teams, MLB Network, and MLB Big Inning.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »
Plus -- with or without a subscription -- Minor League games featuring MLB's top prospects are available FREE at the top of this article and on the MLB Pipeline and MiLB homepages.
TUESDAY

6 p.m. ET: Reading Fightin Phils (PHI) vs. Portland Sea Dogs (BOS)Red Sox fans, direct your attention to Double-A Portland for an eventful week in the organization. Not only is Roman Anthony's long-awaited rehab assignment set to kick off, but it will coincide with the Eastern League debut of Justin Gonzales (BOS No. 2/MLB No. 79). The latter is fresh off a two-homer performance at High-A that raised his OPS to .854 over 89 games. When he steps on the diamond, Gonzales will be the third-youngest player at Double-A (19 years, 7 months, 18 days). Opposing the duo of outfielders will be surging 22-year-old Bryan Rincon (PHI No. 5). The switch-hitting shortstop has showcased an impressive combination of power (18 homers) and speed (25 steals) this season and jumped 24 spots on MLB Pipeline's recent rankings update.
WEDNESDAY

1:10 p.m. ET: Lake County Captains (CLE) vs. Wisconsin Timber Rattlers (MIL)Brady Ebel (MIL No. 5/MLB No. 99) has risen in more way than one in the past week. The 2025 No. 32 overall pick cracked the Top 100 Prospects list for his first time as a pro and followed it up with a promotion to High-A Wisconsin on Monday. Ebel brings a smooth left-handed swing with projectible pop to the Timber Rattlers lineup, along with sneaky speed on the bases. For Lake County, Juneiker Caceres (CLE No. 4/MLB No. 82) anchors the offense. The athletic outfielder has elite bat-to-ball skills and routinely drives the ball for extra bases. Caceres is joined by Welbyn Francisca (CLE No. 21), an exciting middle infielder who earned Prospect Team of the Week honors after delivering nine hits -- including a homer -- over five games last week.

6:07 p.m. ET: Altoona Curve (PIT) vs. Binghamton Rumble Ponies (NYM)It didn't take long for Jefferson Rojas (NYM No. 1/MLB No. 76) to announce his presence in his new organization. The 21-year-old shortstop -- acquired from the Cubs prior to the Trade Deadline -- tallied three knocks in his fourth game for Double-A Binghamton, and did it again two days later, this time with a homer. Rojas -- who has posted career highs in big flies (16) and RBIs (68) this season -- leads the Mets affiliate against Altoona and Murf Gray (PIT No. 4/MLB No. 95). Drafted 73rd overall in 2025, Gray has burst onto the scene in his first pro season. He entered the week leading Pittsburgh's system in hits (120) and total bases (222) and ranking second in homers (27) and OPS (.976).
THURSDAY

7:05 p.m. ET: West Michigan Whitecaps (DET) vs. South Bend Cubs (CHC)Bryce Rainer (DET No. 3/MLB No. 48) closed last week on an absolute heater. He homered in the final three games, collecting two knocks in each contest. The 6-foot-3 shortstop hits the ball as hard as anybody. Last season, his 90th-percentile exit velocity numbers were in line with MLB All-Stars Juan Soto and Rafael Devers. Rainer will aim to unleash his plus pop as High-A West Michigan matches up against South Bend. The Cubs affiliate features a prolific slugger of its own in Josiah Hartshorn (CHC No. 1/MLB No. 39). The switch-hitting 2025 sixth-rounder has massive raw pop and was recently identified as the top first base prospect on MLB Pipeline's "All-Teen" team.

9:35 p.m. ET: Vancouver Canadians (TOR) vs. Eugene Emeralds (SF)After posting an .859 OPS with 13 homers across 87 games at Single-A, JoJo Parker (TOR No. 1/MLB No. 26) was promoted to High-A last week -- and delivered in his first series. Toronto's 2025 first-rounder tallied knocks in each of his first five games with Vancouver and entered this week with hits in all 10 games this month. He'll captain the infield for the Blue Jays affiliate against fellow toolsy shortstop Jhonny Level (SF No. 4/MLB No. 47). A switch-hitter with a smooth swing and above-average speed, Level is closing in on the first 20/20 season of his young career. Additionally, Trade Deadline acquisition Henry Lalane (SF No. 11) will start for the Emeralds. Standing 6-foot-7, the lanky southpaw creates elite extension and touches 98 mph with his heater.
FRIDAY

6 p.m. ET: Reading Fightin Phils (PHI) vs. Portland Sea Dogs (BOS)In a rare repeat Free Game of the Day matchup, the Sea Dogs and Fightin Phils go head-to-head for the second time this week. Rehabbing franchise cornerstone Roman Anthony joins forces with recently promoted prospect Justin Gonzales (BOS No. 2/MLB No. 79) to headline Boston's affiliate. Anthony has been taking reps off the pitching machine, but this week's series marks the former No. 1 overall prospect's first game action since May 4. Toeing the rubber opposite Portland will be 2025 first-rounder Gage Wood (PHI No. 1/MLB No. 33). Wood possesses some of the best stuff in the Minors -- highlighted by his 70-grade four-seamer -- and has registered 112 strikeouts in 76 innings this season.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
SATURDAY

6:05 p.m. ET: Montgomery Biscuits (TB) vs. Columbus Clingstones (ATL)Just four players across the Minors entered the week with 20/30 seasons already secured. Two of them are in this contest -- Montgomery's Theo Gillen (TB No. 2/MLB No. 12) and Rome's Eric Hartman (ATL No. 1/MLB No. 42). Gillen has posted career highs in nearly every offensive category this season, cementing himself as one of the game's brightest prospects and signaling true five-tool potential. Hartman has tapped into his power in his second pro campaign, while still showing the elite speed that led to 48 stolen bases in 2025. Rounding out the matchup is backstop Caden Bodine (TB No. 3/MLB No. 51), another 2026 standout with a .339/.409/.499 slash line through 97 games.
SUNDAY

5:05 p.m. ET: Biloxi Shuckers (MIL) vs. Rocket City Trash Pandas (LAA)One of the most electric lineups in the Minors just got another charge. As if Jesús Made (MIL No. 1/MLB No. 1), Josh Adamczewski (MIL No. 3/MLB No. 88), Andrew Fischer (MIL No. 6) and Braylon Payne (MIL No. 7) weren't enough, the Brewers promoted Luis Peña (MIL No. 2/MLB No. 21) to Double-A on Monday to give Biloxi five of the organization's top seven prospects. Like Made -- a five-tool teenage phenom who has been the youngest player at Double-A all season -- Peña is an athletic infielder who sports an above-average hit tool and plus speed. He slashed .305/.394/.437 across 54 High-A games this year. Looking to match the offense of the prospect-laden Brewers affiliate will be Angels Deadline acquisition Arjun Nimmala (LAA No. 1/MLB No. 38). Selected in the first-round in 2023, Nimmala has impressive raw power and the potential to become a 25-homer shortstop.

9:05 p.m. ET: San Jose Giants (SF) vs. Lake Elsinore Storm (SD)The Giants made the biggest jump on MLB Pipeline's refreshed farm system rankings, and it can be credited in large part to flashy Single-A shortstops Josuar Gonzalez (SF No. 1/MLB No. 17) and Luis Hernández (SF No. 2/MLB No. 27). The duo has taken off like a rocket in 2026, climbing through the system and up the prospect rankings. The speedy Gonzalez excels at swatting extra-base hits and letting his wheels take over. Hernández has more pop and an extremely advanced approach. Both have a knack for getting on base. Signed internationally in consecutive years, the pair of teenagers create instant offense with their full toolsets. On the other side of the NL West affiliate showdown is catcher Ty Harvey (SD No. 4), a 2025 fifth-rounder who stands out for his power at the dish and his arm strength behind it.

items.titleEn: Sánchez's adventurous day in left proves costly when comeback falls short
bodyEn: ST. PETERSBURG -- Jesús Sánchez looked a little lost. Twice.

His multiple misadventures in left field proved decisive in the Blue Jays’ 7-6 loss to the Rays on Wednesday night at Tropicana Field. Toronto’s offense battled valiantly to nearly erase a six-run deficit in the middle innings. But the fact is that the club shouldn’t have been trailing by that much in the first place.
“Today wasn't the best day for him,” manager John Schneider said of his left fielder.

The first miscue came in the first inning, when Rays star slugger Junior Caminero skied a ball down the left-field line. The ball was so high, it might have crossed over one of Tropicana Field’s catwalks, raising the degree of difficulty for Sánchez, who was trying to find a white ball against a white roof that was lit up by the bright Florida sun.
Vladdy (concussion) continues to progress, on track to return this weekend

Sánchez briefly looked down to gauge his position as he reached the left-field corner. That glance might have cost Sánchez, who then began to backpeddle and made a desperate stab at the ball as it bounced off the turf and over the short wall for a ground-rule double.
“Kind of looked like he took his eye off it on the first one, and it's tough to find it after that,” Schneider said.

If that ball is caught, Yandy Díaz doesn’t come to the plate with a runner on and two out in the first inning. But he did, and when he got a hanging slider from Max Scherzer, he smashed it a Statcast-projected 414 feet to left-center for a two-run homer.

“That's not acceptable,” Scherzer said of the slider that spun over the heart of the plate. “I'm a team guy; I don't sit here and point fingers and talk about other people's mistakes. I talk about my mistakes, and I'm accountable.”

The more puzzling outfield play occurred in the fourth inning, when Rays second baseman Richie Palacios lofted a shallow fly ball toward Sánchez. He charged in, but then seemed to lose the ball and only saw it again just before it found the ground about 10 feet to his right. That double scored two runs and opened the floodgates for Tampa Bay, which plated three more runs off Scherzer in the inning on a safety squeeze that resulted in no outs, an RBI bunt single and an RBI groundout. The Rays’ seven runs -- all earned – were charged to Scherzer.

“I'm sure it's a play [Sánchez] would have liked to have made,” Schneider said. “... He kind of looked like he kind of didn’t see it. Or saw it and didn’t see it. You’ve got to check with him on what he saw.”

Sánchez, who left the clubhouse before it opened to the media postgame, is routinely subbed out for a defensive replacement when the Blue Jays are leading in the late innings. His minus-6 outs above average is the lowest on the team, although much of that comes from his work in right field.
Still, any defensive shortcomings from Sánchez are not due to a lack of effort.
“He works,” Schneider said. “If a guy wasn't working, you'd be [upset], but he works at it.”

Toronto almost made those miscues a footnote as it chipped away in the fourth and fifth innings. That included a solo homer in the fourth from the red-hot Alejandro Kirk. It was his third dinger in his past five games and his sixth in his past seven games against the Rays.

Kirk added an RBI single one inning later. Charles McAdoo and Kazuma Okamoto also contributed run-scoring singles in the fifth, and McAdoo added an RBI double in the sixth to help turn a 7-1 blowout into a 7-6 nail-biter.
Five Blue Jays relievers kept the Rays at bay, setting up exactly the situation the Blue Jays wanted in the ninth: Kirk at the plate with two outs and the tying run on second base.

As he has done in just about every at-bat over the past few weeks, Kirk made solid contact, barreling up a high fastball from Rays closer Bryan Baker. It came off of Kirk’s bat at 100 mph and had a .470 expected batting average, but the line drive to right-center field found Cedric Mullins’ glove on the warning track to end it.
“Just a little bit lower in the zone, I think Kirky gets it,” Schneider said.

items.summaryZh: Sánchez左外野两次失误，蓝鸟7-6不敌光芒。
bodyZh: 圣彼得堡——Jesús Sánchez看起来有些迷失。两次。
他在左外野的多次失误成为周三晚上蓝鸟在纯品康纳球场以7-6输给光芒的关键。多伦多的进攻顽强战斗，几乎在中局抹平6分的差距。但事实是，球队本不该落后那么多。
“今天对他来说不是最好的一天，”主教练John Schneider谈到他的左外野手时说。
第一次失误出现在第一局，当时光芒的明星强打者Junior Caminero把球击向左外野边线。球飞得很高，可能越过纯品康纳球场的一个天桥，这让Sánchez在佛州明亮阳光照射下的白色屋顶中寻找白色球时，接球难度大增。
Vladdy（脑震荡）持续恢复，有望本周末回归。
Sánchez到达左外野角落时短暂低头判断位置。正是这一瞥可能害了Sánchez，他开始后退并拼命去扑球，球弹到草地后越过矮墙，形成规则二垒安打。
“看起来他第一次没有盯住球，之后就更难找到了，”Schneider说。
如果那个球被接住，Yandy Díaz就不会在第一局两出局有跑者时上场打击。但他上场了，面对Max Scherzer的一记悬挂滑球，他将其轰出Statcast预测的414英尺，飞向左中外野，形成两分本垒打。
“那不可接受，”Scherzer谈到那颗在好球带中央旋转的滑球时说。“我是团队型球员；我不会坐在这里指责别人，谈论别人的错误。我只谈自己的错误，我会承担责任。”
更令人费解的外野防守出现在第四局，当时光芒二垒手Richie Palacios朝Sánchez打出一记浅飞球。他向内冲，但随后似乎失去了球，直到球落在他右侧约10英尺的地面之前才重新看到。那支二垒安打打进两分，为坦帕湾打开闸门，光芒在该局对Scherzer再添三分，包括一次无人出局的安全抢分、一支打点触击安打和一支打点滚地球出局。光芒的七分——全部是自责分——都记在Scherzer账上。
“我相信这是Sánchez想要完成的防守，”Schneider说。“……他看起来好像有点没看到球。或者看到了又没看到。你得问问他当时看到了什么。”
Sánchez在赛后媒体开放前离开了更衣室，他通常在蓝鸟比赛后段领先时被替换为防守替补。他的防守出局数贡献为-6，为全队最低，尽管其中大部分来自他在右外野的表现。
尽管如此，Sánchez在防守上的不足并非因为不努力。
“他很努力，”Schneider说。“如果一个球员不努力，你会（生气），但他很努力。”
多伦多在第四和第五局不断追分，几乎让这些失误成为注脚。其中包括状态火热的Alejandro Kirk在第四局的阳春本垒打。这是他在过去五场比赛中的第三支本垒打，也是过去七场对阵光芒比赛中的第六支。
下一局，Kirk又打出一支打点一垒安打。Charles McAdoo和Kazuma Okamoto在第五局也贡献了打点一垒安打，McAdoo在第六局又补了一支打点二垒安打，帮助将7-1的悬殊比分变成了7-6的紧张对决。
五位蓝鸟后援投手限制了光芒，正好营造了蓝鸟在第九局想要的情况：Kirk上场打击，两出局，追平分在二垒。
正如过去几周几乎每次打击一样，Kirk扎实地用棒头击中了光芒终结者Bryan Baker的一记高位快速球。球以100英里/小时的速度飞出，预期打击率高达.470，但这支飞向右中外野的平飞球在警告区被Cedric Mullins的手套接住，比赛结束。
“我觉得只要在好球带稍微低一点，Kirky就能打中，”Schneider说。

items.titleEn: Vladdy (concussion) continues to progress, on track to return this weekend
bodyEn: ST. PETERSBURG -- Four days into his stint on the seven-day concussion injured list, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is making significant strides in his recovery.

The Blue Jays’ star went through an on-field workout at Tropicana Field prior to the team’s series opener against the AL East-leading Rays on Tuesday. He went through drills, ran on the field and hit inside the batting cage. It was Guerrero’s greatest amount of baseball activity since he went on the IL on Saturday, one day after a collision at third base with the Yankees’ George Lombard Jr. left Guerrero concussed.
“Still kind of taking it day to day with him,” manager John Schneider said of Guerrero, “but good that he's doing stuff and feeling better.”

Guerrero could be activated from the injured list as early as Saturday. Schneider said he’s hoping for such an outcome, but the club will continue to monitor how the six-time All-Star is feeling over the next few days. Schneider said there’s a chance Guerrero could face live pitching while Toronto grinds through its three-game series against the Rays. That’s a possibility since the team is playing not too far from its Spring Training complex in Dunedin, Fla.
“As soon as he's ready, feeling good and cleared and he feels like he's got his timing, we're going to try to get him back in there,” Schneider said.
Guerrero is batting .263 with seven home runs and a .693 OPS in what has been a very frustrating year for him.
items.titleZh: 弗拉迪（脑震荡）持续恢复，有望本周末回归
items.summaryZh: 弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗脑震荡恢复进展顺利，最早周六复出。
bodyZh: 圣彼得堡——进入七天脑震荡伤病名单的第四天，小弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗的恢复取得了显著进展。
这位蓝鸟球星周二在球队对阵美联东区领头羊光芒的系列赛揭幕战前，于纯品康纳球场进行了场上训练。他完成了各项训练，在场上跑步并在打击笼内挥棒。这是格雷罗自周六进入伤病名单以来最大运动量的棒球活动。此前一天，他在三垒与洋基的George Lombard Jr.相撞导致脑震荡。
“对他还是只能一天天观察，”经理John Schneider谈到格雷罗时说，“但好在他现在能进行活动，感觉也好多了。”
格雷罗最早可能于周六从伤病名单中激活。Schneider表示他希望如此，但球队将在接下来几天持续监测这位六届全明星球员的感受。Schneider表示，在多伦多与光芒的三场系列赛期间，格雷罗有机会面对实战投球。这有可能实现，因为球队比赛的场地距离其位于佛罗里达州达尼丁的春训基地不远。
“一旦他准备好、感觉良好并获准参赛，而且觉得自己的打击时机找回来了，我们就会尝试让他回归，”Schneider说。
格雷罗本赛季到目前为止表现非常令人沮丧，他目前打击率为.263，有7支本垒打，OPS为.693。

items.titleEn: Kirk, Blue Jays exorcise their Trop tribulations with 10-run performance
bodyEn: ST. PETERSBURG -- The Blue Jays’ lineup has waited for a night like Tuesday for about six weeks.

The fact that it came against the team with the best record in the American League and inside a stadium that has been the site of so much disappointment for Toronto made its outburst that much more remarkable.

The Blue Jays crushed three homers in their 10-5 series-opening victory over the Rays at Tropicana Field. It was the first time the Blue Jays had scored double-digit runs since their 10-0 win over the Giants on July 8 -- 34 games ago.

That game was also the last time the Blue Jays plated multiple runs in the first inning. But they did that Tuesday thanks to an RBI single from George Springer and an RBI double by Jesús Sánchez. And the bats just didn’t stop; Toronto scored two runs in the third, fourth, fifth and seventh innings.

Catcher Alejandro Kirk, who finished a triple shy of the cycle, cracked the club’s first homer of the game -- a two-run shot to left-center in the third. Kazuma Okamoto followed with a solo dinger to the same area of the Trop, though his landed about 30 feet further into the seats. His Statcast-projected 442-foot clout was his first in 17 games and his 25th of the season, breaking a tie with Eric Hinske for the most homers by a Blue Jays rookie.
Josh Smith then lined a two-run shot out to right field in the seventh inning.

Most of the damage came against Rays starter and All-Star right-hander Nick Martinez, who had limited Toronto to two runs on two hits through two previous starts (11 innings) this season. On Tuesday, the Blue Jays tagged him for six runs in 3 2/3 frames in Martinez’s shortest outing of the year.

The 10 runs were also the most the Blue Jays have posted inside Tropicana Field since a 20-1 triumph on May 23, 2023. Toronto entered with a .393 all-time winning percentage at the Trop (92-142) and had scored a grand total of nine runs in its past six games here -- all losses.
items.titleZh: Kirk和蓝鸟以10分表现摆脱Trop球场困扰
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟客场10-5击败光芒，Kirk差三垒安打完成完全打击，Okamoto创队史新秀本垒打纪录。
bodyZh: 圣彼得堡——蓝鸟的打线已经等了大约六周才迎来一个像周二这样的夜晚。
这一爆发发生在面对美联战绩最佳的球队，且是在一座给多伦多带来过太多失望的球场里，这让他们的爆发更加难以置信。
蓝鸟在Tropicana Field以10-5击败光芒，取得系列赛首胜，他们轰出三支本垒打。这是蓝鸟自7月8日10-0战胜巨人以来首次单场得分达到两位数，距今已有34场比赛。
那场比赛也是蓝鸟上一次在首局攻下多分。但周二他们做到了，这要归功于George Springer的带打点一垒安打和Jesús Sánchez的带打点二垒安打。而且打线没有停歇；多伦多在第三、四、五、七局各得两分。
捕手Alejandro Kirk差一支三垒安打就能完成完全打击，他敲出球队本场第一支本垒打——第三局一支飞向左中外野的两分炮。Kazuma Okamoto紧随其后，将球轰到Trop球场的同一区域，但他的球飞入观众席的落点还要再远约30英尺。Statcast显示他的这发442英尺本垒打是他17场比赛以来的第一支，也是本赛季第25支，打破了与Eric Hinske并列的蓝鸟新秀本垒打纪录。
随后Josh Smith在第七局击出一支飞向右外野的两分本垒打。
蓝鸟的大部分得分都是在对阵光芒先发投手、全明星右投Nick Martinez时取得的，他本赛季前两次先发（共11局）面对多伦多时仅让对手得到两分、击出两支安打。但在周二，蓝鸟在Martinez今年最短的出场中，于3又2/3局内从他手中攻下六分。
这10分也是蓝鸟自2023年5月23日以20-1取胜以来在Tropicana Field获得的最高单场得分。赛前多伦多在Trop球场的历史胜率为.393（92胜142负），并且过去六次造访这里总共只得到九分——全部落败。
items.author: Brian Murphy

items.titleEn: With 25th homer, Okamoto breaks Blue Jays' rookie home run record
bodyEn: ST. PETERSBURG -- Kazuma Okamoto owns the Blue Jays’ rookie home run record -- finally.

The slugging infielder snapped a 16-game homerless streak with a Statcast-projected 442-foot solo shot in the fifth inning of Tuesday’s series opener against the Rays at Tropicana Field. The dinger -- the second-longest of Okamoto’s rookie year -- was Okamoto’s 25th of the season, breaking a tie with Eric Hinske for the franchise record. Hinske was the American League Rookie of the Year in 2002, when he crushed 24 homers.

Okamoto was the AL Rookie of the Month for June and then went deep in three of his first eight games in July. But he has been slumping since then, with just two homers and a .196/.250/.304 slash line in his previous 30 games leading into Tuesday’s game against the best team in the American League.
Okamoto’s long drive to left-center was Toronto’s seventh run of the contest. After the Blue Jays put up another run in the fifth, they had scored their most runs since July 8 -- a span of 33 games.
items.titleZh: 冈本第25轰创蓝鸟新秀本垒打纪录
items.summaryZh: 冈本第25轰打破蓝鸟新秀本垒打纪录。
bodyZh: 圣彼得堡——Kazuma Okamoto终于独享蓝鸟新秀本垒打纪录。
这位重炮内野手在周二于Tropicana Field对阵光芒的系列赛首战第五局轰出一支Statcast测算为442英尺的阳春炮，终结了连续16场无本垒打的低迷。这支本垒打——冈本新秀赛季第二远的一支——是本赛季第25支，打破了与Eric Hinske并列的队史纪录。Hinske在2002年轰出24支本垒打，荣膺美国联盟年度最佳新秀。
冈本曾当选6月美联月度最佳新秀，并在7月前8场比赛中3次开轰。但此后他陷入低迷，在周二对阵美联最佳球队之前，此前30场比赛中仅有两支本垒打，打击三围为.196/.250/.304。
冈本打到左中看台的长打是蓝鸟本场第7分。在第五局再添一分后，蓝鸟单场得分创下自7月8日以来（时隔33场）新高。

items.titleEn: Cease garners first-place votes in latest Cy Young poll
bodyEn: The Cy Young races in both leagues appear pretty well set as we head toward the final six weeks of the season. Cam Schlittler of the Yankees and Jacob Misiorowski of the Brewers have each seemingly had their respective awards on lock for the past few months, and that hasn't changed in our latest MLB.com Cy Young poll.

Schlittler and Misiorowski were again the clear frontrunners among the 35 experts who participated in the poll, with The Miz being a unanimous choice with voters. But that doesn't mean there aren't others putting together dominant seasons worthy of Cy Young consideration.

As always, our experts made their picks based not only on results so far this season, but also on how things are expected to go the rest of the way. Voters were asked to rank their top five picks in each league. Pitchers received vote points on a 5-4-3-2-1 scale -- five points for a first-place vote, four points for a second-place vote and so on. Here are the results.
All stats are through Sunday unless otherwise noted.
AMERICAN LEAGUE
1. Cam Schlittler, Yankees (165 total points; 25 first-place votes)

Schlittler has consistently led the way among AL pitchers this season. His 2.16 ERA is the league's best, as are his 152 innings pitched and his 5.1 bWAR. Meanwhile, his 0.94 WHIP is just a few ticks off the lead and his .196 opponents' average is second-best in the Junior Circuit. He's allowed more than three earned runs just three times all season and has allowed one or no runs in 18 of his 26 starts. He also has an 11.19 K/9 ratio, which is why his strikeout rate ranks in baseball's 95th percentile. It's easy to see why he's the easy favorite.
2. Dylan Cease, Blue Jays (148 total points; 10 first-place votes)

For as dominant as Schlittler has been, Cease has been even better when it comes to strikeouts. The righty's 201 punchouts are most in the AL, and his 13.14 K/9 ratio is easily the best among the league's qualified starters. He's good at limiting runs, too, with a 2.42 ERA that's second in the league behind Schlittler's. Cease has been especially stingy since the beginning of July. Since July 3, he's posted a 1.49 ERA in eight starts.
3. Drew Rasmussen, Rays (79 total points)

No qualified AL starter has kept runners off base better than Rasmussen. His 0.91 WHIP is the league's best, in large part because he just doesn't issue walks. He's walked just 23 batters all season, the second fewest of any qualified starter in the AL. Rasmussen's 2.78 ERA ranks sixth in the league, helped significantly by a 1.20 ERA over his past five starts, which included three straight scoreless outings.
4. Parker Messick, Guardians (54 total points)

Messick, both an AL Cy Young contender and an AL Rookie of the Year candidate, moves up one spot from our last poll. The lefty's 2.59 ERA ranks third in the AL, while his 1.03 WHIP ranks fifth. He's not allowed more than two earned runs in a start since late June and has pitched to a 1.96 ERA since July 4. His 107 hits allowed this season are the sixth-fewest in the AL.
5. Sonny Gray, Red Sox (41 total points)

Gray's 15 wins are second in the Majors, while his 2.65 ERA ranks fourth in the AL. The 14-year veteran's first season with the Red Sox is proving to be one of the best of his career. He has 16 quality starts and has allowed a total of two runs so far in three August outings. Most importantly, the Red Sox are 17-6 in Gray's starts.

*Others receiving votes: Nick Martinez, Rays; Gavin Williams, Guardians; Sean Burke, White Sox; Logan Gilbert, Mariners; Payton Tolle, Red Sox; Bryan Baker, Rays; Louis Varland, Blue Jays; Reid Detmers, Angels*
NATIONAL LEAGUE
1. Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers (175 total points; 35 first-place votes)

The Miz not only leads the NL in a slew of important categories -- he leads all of baseball. His 1.75 ERA is easily the lowest among all qualified starters, while his 210 strikeouts lead Cease's 201 for the most in the Majors. Then there's his MLB-best 2.14 FIP, 0.75 WHIP and .151 opponents' average. He allows opponents an average of 4.7 hits per nine innings and has a 13.60 K/9 ratio, both also the best in the bigs. This is about as easy a choice as there ever will be.
2. Cristopher Sánchez, Phillies (116 total points)

If you want to make an argument against Misiorowski as a lock for NL Cy Young, you could point out that Sánchez leads all MLB pitchers with 6.6 bWAR. You could also mention that his 16 wins following Monday's outing lead the Majors. When you consider those things along with his 187 strikeouts, which rank second in the NL, and his 2.51 ERA, which ranks fourth, he certainly has a compelling case.
3. Chris Sale, Braves (113 total points)

Sale remains the oldest pitcher to rank in this poll, but his age (37) is apparently just another impressive number for him. The lefty ranks second in the Majors with a 2.16 ERA, while his 1.02 WHIP ranks third in the NL and his 160 strikeouts rank sixth. Speaking of strikeouts, Sale is on track for his ninth season with 200 or more. Meanwhile, he's allowed more than three earned runs just once all season.
4. Yoshinobu Yamamoto, Dodgers (49 total points)

Yamamoto is another guy who makes it really hard for batters to reach base. His 0.89 WHIP is the second lowest in the bigs and he's held opponents to a .186 average, which is third best among qualified starters. So, as you might imagine, that makes it hard to score. Fittingly, his 2.60 ERA ranks fifth in the NL. But since mid-May, a span of 14 starts, it's 2.08.
5. Chase Burns, Reds (38 total points)

Burns is enjoying an outstanding sophomore season in the Majors. The righty's 14 wins are the third cond most of any pitcher in the bigs, while his 2.47 ERA and .204 opponents' average both rank third in the NL. Burns has won 13 of his past 14 decisions (including 12 straight wins from April 21-Aug. 2) and the Reds are 17-6 in his starts.
*Others receiving votes: Jesús Luzardo, Phillies; Mason Miller, Padres; Zack Wheeler, Phillies; Paul Skenes, Pirates; Eduardo Rodriguez, D-backs; Sandy Alcantara, Marlins*
items.titleZh: 最新赛扬奖投票：Cease获第一名选票
items.summaryZh: 最新赛扬奖投票中，蓝鸟投手Cease获得10张第一名选票，排名美联第二。
bodyZh: 本赛季进入最后六周，两个联盟的赛扬奖竞争似乎已趋于明朗。纽约洋基的Cam Schlittler和密尔沃基酿酒人的Jacob Misiorowski在过去几个月里似乎都已锁定各自联盟的奖项，而这一情况在我们最新的MLB.com赛扬奖投票中也没有改变。
在参与投票的35位专家中，Schlittler和Misiorowski再次成为明显的领跑者，其中The Miz获得了一致票选。但这并不意味着没有其他人打出了值得赛扬奖考虑的主导赛季。
与往常一样，我们的专家不仅根据本赛季迄今的表现做出选择，还考虑了对剩余赛程的预期。投票者被要求对每个联盟的前五名进行排名。投手按5-4-3-2-1的积分制获得选票积分——第一名选票得5分，第二名选票得4分，以此类推。以下是投票结果。
除非另有说明，所有数据截至周日。
美国联盟
1. Cam Schlittler，纽约洋基（总分165分；25张第一名选票）

Schlittler本赛季在美国联盟投手中一直处于领先地位。他的自责分率2.16为联盟最佳，152局的投球局数和5.1的bWAR也同样是联盟最佳。此外，他的WHIP为0.94，与领先者相差无几，而对手打击率.196在美联排名第二。整个赛季他只有三场比赛失分超过三分，在26次先发中有18次失分不超过一分。他的K/9值达到11.19，这就是他的三振率位列全联盟第95百分位的原因。显然，他是当之无愧的大热门。
2. Dylan Cease，多伦多蓝鸟（总分148分；10张第一名选票）
尽管Schlittler表现出色，但在三振方面Cease更为突出。这位右投手的201次三振为美联最多，他的13.14 K/9值也轻松位居联盟合格先发投手之首。他在限制失分方面同样出色，自责分率2.42位列联盟第二，仅次于Schlittler。自7月初以来，Cease尤为吝啬。自7月3日起，他在8场先发中自责分率仅为1.49。
3. Drew Rasmussen，坦帕湾光芒（总分79分）
在美国联盟合格的先发投手中，没有人比Rasmussen更能限制跑者上垒。他的WHIP为0.91，排名联盟第一，很大程度上是因为他几乎不投出保送。整个赛季他只保送了23名打者，为美联合格先发投手中第二少。Rasmussen的自责分率2.78排名联盟第六，这主要得益于过去5场先发中的1.20自责分率，其中包括连续三场无失分表现。
4. Parker Messick，克利夫兰守护者（总分54分）
Messick既是美联赛扬奖竞争者，也是美联年度最佳新秀候选人，较上次投票上升了一个名次。这位左投手的自责分率2.59排名美联第三，WHIP为1.03排名第五。自6月底以来，他没有在任何一场先发中失分超过两分，自7月4日以来的自责分率为1.96。本赛季他被打出107支安打，为美联第六少。
5. Sonny Gray，波士顿红袜（总分41分）
Gray的15胜位居全联盟第二，自责分率2.65则排名美联第四。这位14年老将加盟红袜的首个赛季被证明是他职业生涯中最好的赛季之一。他已有16场优质先发，8月份的三场比赛中总共只失两分。最重要的是，在Gray先发的比赛中，红袜取得了17胜6负的战绩。
*其他获得选票的投手：Nick Martinez，坦帕湾光芒；Gavin Williams，克利夫兰守护者；Sean Burke，芝加哥白袜；Logan Gilbert，西雅图水手；Payton Tolle，波士顿红袜；Bryan Baker，坦帕湾光芒；Louis Varland，多伦多蓝鸟；Reid Detmers，洛杉矶天使*
国家联盟
1. Jacob Misiorowski，密尔沃基酿酒人（总分175分；35张第一名选票）
The Miz不仅在多项重要数据上领跑国联——他领跑整个大联盟。他的自责分率1.75轻松成为所有合格先发投手中最低的，210次三振则超过Cease的201次，领跑全联盟。此外，他的2.14 FIP、0.75 WHIP和.151的对手打击率均为MLB最佳。他每九局平均只被击出4.7支安打，K/9值达到13.60，这两项同样为全联盟最佳。这几乎是有史以来最容易做出的选择。
2. Cristopher Sánchez，费城费城人（总分116分）
如果你想反驳Misiorowski锁定国联赛扬奖的观点，你可以指出Sánchez以6.6的bWAR领跑所有MLB投手。你还可以提到，他在周一先发后以16胜领跑全联盟。当你把这些因素连同他排名国联第二的187次三振和排名第四的2.51自责分率放在一起考虑时，他显然有很强的说服力。
3. Chris Sale，亚特兰大勇士（总分113分）
Sale仍然是本次投票中年龄最大的投手，但37岁的年龄显然只是他的另一个亮眼数字。这位左投手的自责分率2.16排名全联盟第二，WHIP为1.02排名国联第三，160次三振排名第六。说到三振，Sale有望迎来生涯第九个单赛季200次三振的赛季。此外，他整个赛季只有一次失分超过三分。
4. Yoshinobu Yamamoto，洛杉矶道奇（总分49分）
Yamamoto是另一个让打者极难上垒的投手。他的WHIP为0.89，为全联盟第二低，他将对手打击率限制在.186，在合格先发投手中排名第三。所以，可以想象，这让他们很难得分。相应地，他的自责分率2.60排名国联第五。但自5月中旬以来，在14场先发中，自责分率为2.08。
5. Chase Burns，辛辛那提红人（总分38分）
Burns正在大联盟度过一个出色的二年级赛季。这位右投手的14胜为全联盟第三多，自责分率2.47和对手打击率.204均排名国联第三。Burns在过去14次决定中赢得了13次（包括4月21日至8月2日的12连胜），在他先发的比赛中红人取得了17胜6负的战绩。
*其他获得选票的投手：Jesús Luzardo，费城费城人；Mason Miller，圣迭戈教士；Zack Wheeler，费城费城人；Paul Skenes，匹兹堡海盗；Eduardo Rodriguez，亚利桑那响尾蛇；Sandy Alcantara，迈阿密马林鱼*

items.titleEn: Triple-A 3B Keys hits his way onto Prospect Team of the Week
bodyEn: The Prospect Team of the Week is our space at MLB Pipeline to honor the top performers around the Minor Leagues.

Per our rules, Minor League players must be ranked among their club's Top 30 prospects on Pipeline's lists to be eligible for the honors. Sometimes, of course, a non-ranked player has a week worth celebrating.

This week, we couldn't share our top performers without mentioning Braves second baseman/outfielder Dixon Williams, who had a week to remember. The 136th overall pick in last year's Draft, who began the year as Atlanta's No. 28 prospect, collected eight hits, five homers and 16 RBIs across Saturday and Sunday's games.

Alas, Williams won't be able to make it onto the Prospect Team of the Week -- maybe in the future if he is ranked again -- but the alternatives were quite strong at second base and in the outfield. There's no shortage of notable performances on this squad, which includes a 17-year-old on the Top 100.
This is the Prospect Team of the Week for Aug. 10-16:
C: Franklin Primera, Salem RidgeYaks (Single-A)Red Sox No. 4.474/.600/.789, 6 G, 9-for-19, 1 HR, 1 3B, 1 2B, 3 RBI, 6 R, 5 BB, 1 K, 1 SB

At 19, Primera is the second-youngest catcher in the Carolina League, but he's fitting in just fine, with a .333/.474/.509 slash line in 31 games. The Venezuela native has hit safely in 13 straight starts, including a four-hit performance to start last series. After drawing five more free passes last week, Primera has more walks (19) than strikeouts (17) at Single-A and has a 41/33 ratio when including his time in the Rookie-level Florida Complex League. This is his second appearance on a Prospect Team of the Week in the past five editions.
1B: Luis Fragoza, Fort Myers Mighty Mussels (Single-A)Twins No. 27.667/.800/1.583, 5 G, 8-for-12, 3 HR, 2 2B, 6 RBI, 9 R, 7 BB, 4 K, 5 SB

The 6-foot-1 native of Venezuela has intriguing right-handed thump -- he ranks in the 73rd percentile of the Florida State League with a 40.9 percent hard-hit rate -- and has been putting it on display lately. He delivered his second multihomer game of the season on Thursday, which kicked off a run of four straight games reaching base safely at least three times. Fragoza has cycled between the infield corners and all three outfield spots and has a robust .322/.398/.607 slash line with 14 homers and 15 steals in 59 games.
2B: Aron Estrada, Chesapeake Baysox (Double-A)Orioles No. 13.474/.476/1.316, 5 G, 9-for-19, 5 HR, 1 2B, 10 RBI, 6 R, 1 BB, 3 K

The 5-foot-11 Estrada has long carried a hit-over-power profile but is in the midst of a slugging breakout this season. After going deep five times this week -- including once against MLB's No. 33 prospect Gage Wood -- he's almost homered as much this season (21) as he has in his first four seasons combined (23). The switch-hitter has been far better batting lefty this season (.301/.331/.578) than he has batting right-handed (.248/.293/.312).
3B: Sean Keys, Buffalo Bisons (Triple-A)Blue Jays No. 6.455/.600/.909, 6 G, 10-for-22, 3 HR, 1 2B, 7 RBI, 8 R, 6 BB, 3 K

Keys returns to the Prospect Team of the Week for the fourth time this season -- he made it twice in April and once in June -- as he continues to mash while playing the infield corners. The right-handed slugger has picked up multiple hits in five of his past seven games and is once again hitting the ball extremely hard. Half of his homers that Statcast has measured at Triple-A have gone at 110 mph or harder, including a 417-foot shot on Wednesday.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
SS: Welbyn Francisca, Lake County Captains (High-A)Guardians No. 21.474/.545/.842, 5 G, 9-for-19, 1 HR, 4 2B, 2 RBI, 5 R, 3 BB, 4 K, 1 CS

Francisca has been on an absolute tear, with 18 hits in his past 10 games, which included a stretch of four homers in five games. The switch-hitter has boosted his High-A OPS 147 points to .960 during that stretch while getting everyday reps at shortstop after previously splitting his time between short and second. The 19-year-old missed the start of the season with a shoulder injury but has been quite productive, especially against righties (.286/.399/.584), since his return.
OF: Francisco Renteria, DSL Phillies (ROK)Phillies No. 3/MLB No. 81.667/.769/1.444, 5 G, 12-for-18, 3 HR, 2 3B, 1 2B, 11 RBI, 11 R, 7 BB, 4 K, 5 SB, 1 CS

The Phillies had high expectations for Renteria when they signed him for $4 million as the No. 3 prospect in the 2026 international class, and he's quickly living up to that billing. The 6-foot-3 athlete leads the Rookie-level Dominican Summer League with a 1.159 OPS while posting 11 homers and walking (34) almost as much as he's struck out (36). Last week, he delivered three consecutive three-hit performances and picked up extra bases on half his knocks. He's also used his plus speed efficiently on the bases, with 24 steals on 28 attempts this season.
OF: Bo Davidson, Sacramento River Cats (Triple-A)Giants No. 8.560/.607/1.160, 6 G, 14-for-25, 4 HR, 3 2B, 12 RBI, 6 R, 2 BB, 3 K

It's been quite a week for Davidson, who marked the end of his first month at the highest level of the Minor Leagues with his first professional grand slam and a career-high eight RBIs. The 24-year-old, who signed out of juco as a non-drafted free agent in 2023, delivered a pair of four-hit games as he increased his Triple-A OPS from .536 to .820 in a matter of six days. Despite his slow start with the River Cats, Davidson, who also made a Prospect Team of the Week in June, ranks in the 91st percentile on the circuit with a 47.8 percent hard-hit rate.
OF: Dylan Dreiling, Frisco RoughRiders (Double-A)Rangers No. 13.524/.565/1.190, 5 G, 11-for-21, 4 HR, 2 2B, 7 RBI, 6 R, 2 BB, 4 K

The 2024 second-rounder has hit safely every game in August and picked up multiple knocks in four of five games last week. Dreiling went deep four times in three games, which made him the only Rangers prospect with at least 20 homers and 10 steals this season, underscoring his balanced skill set. Although all of his homers came against righties this week, he's shown remarkably little platoon split, going .311/.375/.543 against fellow southpaws and .283/.389/.500 against righties.
LHP: Reinold Navarro, Bradenton Marauders (Single-A)Pirates No. 211-0, 0.00 ERA, 1 G, 1 GS, 5 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 0 BB, 6 K, 0.20 WHIP

Navarro has stood out for his strikeout stuff since signing for $270,000 two years ago. Through three pro seasons, the Dominican Republic native has a 38.1 percent strikeout rate; the issue has been a 21.4 percent walk rate. That made his most recent start all the more impressive, as he gave up one hit and did not issue a free pass in five scoreless innings. Hitters have had trouble touching any of his pitches this season, with a sub-.200 average and whiff rate above 40 percent on his fastball, slider and changeup.
RHP: David Davalillo, Round Rock Express (Triple-A)Rangers No. 150-0, 0.00 ERA, 1 G, 1 GS, 6 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 0 BB, 7 K, 0.17 WHIP

Davalillo hails from a big baseball family and stands out for his wide arsenal and pitchability. He showed as much on Friday as he struck out seven batters on five different pitches and allowed just one baserunner in a scoreless start. The 25-year-old notably pitched six innings for just the second time this year and needed just 76 pitches to do so. The 6-foot-1 right-hander, who also made a Prospect Team of the Week in April 2025, has one of the best splitters in the Minors, a low-80s offering against which opponents are hitting .158 and slugging .211.
RP: Ty Johnson, Durham Bulls (Triple-A)Rays No. 100-0, 0.00 ERA, 2 G, 3 IP, 0 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 0 BB, 6 K, 0.00 WHIP

After starting in his first 10 outings of the season, Johnson has shifted to relief -- and been absolutely dominant in August. The 6-foot-6 right-hander gets plenty of deception and extension on his delivery, which helps him pick up a ton of whiffs with a 50-50 fastball-slider combination. The 2023 15th-rounder has nine strikeouts to just one hit and one walk allowed over six scoreless innings in five outings this month. If he can develop his underused changeup, he could start again, but he has the ingredients to dominate in relief without it.
items.titleZh: 三A三垒手Keys入选本周潜力新秀阵容
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟三垒手Keys本赛季第四次入选本周潜力新秀阵容。
bodyZh: 本周潜力新秀阵容是MLB Pipeline为表彰小联盟中表现最佳的球员而设立的专栏。
根据我们的规则，小联盟球员必须位列Pipeline榜单上其球队前30大新秀之中才有资格入选。当然，有时未上榜的球员也会有值得庆祝的一周。
本周，不提勇士队二垒手/外野手Dixon Williams就无法完整展示我们评选出的最佳球员，他度过了一个难忘的星期。这位去年选秀的第136顺位新秀，年初是亚特兰大排名第28的潜力新秀，在周六和周日两场比赛中累计击出8支安打、5支本垒打和16分打点。
可惜，Williams无法入选本周潜力新秀阵容——如果未来他能再次进入榜单，或许有机会——但在二垒和外野位置上，其他候选人的表现也相当强劲。这份名单上的亮点表现层出不穷，其中包括一位位列百大新秀的17岁球员。
以下是8月10日至16日的本周潜力新秀阵容：
捕手：Franklin Primera，Salem RidgeYaks（单A）红袜第4号新秀。.474/.600/.789，6场比赛，19打数9安打，1本垒打，1三垒安打，1二垒安打，3打点，6得分，5保送，1三振，1盗垒。
19岁的Primera是卡罗莱纳联盟第二年轻的捕手，但他适应得很好，在31场比赛中打出.333/.474/.509的打击三围。这位委内瑞拉籍球员已连续13场先发有安打，包括上一个系列赛首战打出4安打。上周再获5次保送后，Primera在单A的保送数（19）多于三振数（17），计入新人级佛罗里达综合联盟的表现后，保送与三振比为41/33。这是他过去五期潜力新秀阵容中第二次入选。
一垒手：Luis Fragoza，Fort Myers Mighty Mussels（单A）双城第27号新秀。.667/.800/1.583，5场比赛，12打数8安打，3本垒打，2二垒安打，6打点，9得分，7保送，4三振，5盗垒。
这位身高6英尺1英寸的委内瑞拉人拥有颇具吸引力的右手火力——他在佛罗里达州联盟的强击率排名第73百分位，达到40.9%——最近他也将这一能力展现出来。周四他打出本赛季第二场多本垒打比赛，由此开启连续四场至少三次安全上垒的势头。Fragoza在内野角落和全部三个外野位置间轮换，在59场比赛中打出.322/.398/.607的坚实打击三围，并有14支本垒打和15次盗垒。
二垒手：Aron Estrada，Chesapeake Baysox（双A）金莺第13号新秀。.474/.476/1.316，5场比赛，19打数9安打，5本垒打，1二垒安打，10打点，6得分，1保送，3三振。
身高5英尺11英寸的Estrada长期以来展现出安打优于力量的特点，但本赛季正处于长打爆发期。本周他击出5支本垒打——其中一支是面对MLB第33号新秀Gage Wood——本赛季他已打出21支本垒打，几乎接近他前四个赛季总和（23支）。这位左右开弓的打者本赛季左打表现（.301/.331/.578）远好于右打（.248/.293/.312）。
三垒手：Sean Keys，Buffalo Bisons（三A）蓝鸟第6号新秀。.455/.600/.909，6场比赛，22打数10安打，3本垒打，1二垒安打，7打点，8得分，6保送，3三振。
Keys本赛季第四次入选本周潜力新秀阵容——他曾在4月两次、6月一次入选——他在镇守内野角落的同时继续展现强劲打击。这位右打重炮手在过去七场比赛中五场有单场多安打，并再次展现出极强的击球力度。Statcast在3A测量的他的本垒打中，有一半初速达到110英里/小时或更快，包括周三打出的一支417英尺远本垒打。
订阅MLB Pipeline新闻通讯
游击手：Welbyn Francisca，Lake County Captains（高阶A）守护者第21号新秀。.474/.545/.842，5场比赛，19打数9安打，1本垒打，4二垒安打，2打点，5得分，3保送，4三振，1盗垒失败。
Francisca近期状态火热，过去10场比赛击出18支安打，其中包括连续5场4支本垒打的表现。这位左右开弓的打者在这一阶段将高阶A的OPS提升了147个点至.960，此前他在游击和二垒间轮换，如今已在游击手位置获得每日出场机会。这位19岁小将因肩伤缺席赛季开局，但自回归以来表现相当出色，尤其是面对右投时（.286/.399/.584）。
外野手：Francisco Renteria，DSL Phillies（新人级）费城人第3号/MLB第81号新秀。.667/.769/1.444，5场比赛，18打数12安打，3本垒打，2三垒安打，1二垒安打，11打点，11得分，7保送，4三振，5盗垒，1盗垒失败。
费城人队在2026年国际新秀班中以400万美元签下Renteria，将他视为第3号新秀，对他寄予厚望，而他迅速兑现了这份期待。这位身高6英尺3英寸的运动员在新人级多米尼加夏季联盟中以1.159的OPS领跑，同时贡献11支本垒打，保送（34）几乎与三振（36）一样多。上周他连续三场击出三支安打，并且一半的安打是长打。他在垒上也高效运用了自己的加速能力，本赛季28次盗垒尝试中成功24次。
外野手：Bo Davidson，Sacramento River Cats（三A）巨人第8号新秀。.560/.607/1.160，6场比赛，25打数14安打，4本垒打，3二垒安打，12打点，6得分，2保送，3三振。

对Davidson来说，这是相当精彩的一周，他在小联盟最高级别联赛度过第一个月之际，打出生涯首支满贯本垒打，并贡献生涯单场最高的8分打点。这位24岁球员在2023年从初级学院以未选秀自由球员身份签约，他打出两场单场四安打的比赛，并在短短六天内将三A的OPS从.536提升至.820。尽管在River Cats开局缓慢，Davidson——他曾在6月也入选过潜力新秀阵容——该联盟的强击率排在第91百分位，达到47.8%。
外野手：Dylan Dreiling，Frisco RoughRiders（双A）游骑兵第13号新秀。.524/.565/1.190，5场比赛，21打数11安打，4本垒打，2二垒安打，7打点，6得分，2保送，4三振。
这位2024年二轮秀在8月的每场比赛中都有安打，上周5场比赛中4场有单场多安打。Dreiling在三场比赛中击出4支本垒打，这使他成为本赛季唯一一位至少20轰10盗的游骑兵新秀，体现了他全面的技术。尽管本周他的本垒打全部来自面对右投时，但他展现出的左右投差异极小，面对左投时打出.311/.375/.543，面对右投时为.283/.389/.500。
左投手：Reinold Navarro，Bradenton Marauders（单A）海盗第21号新秀。1-0，自责分率0.00，1场，1先发，5局，1安打，0失分，0自责分，0保送，6三振，WHIP 0.20。
自两年前以27万美元签约以来，Navarro就以其三振能力脱颖而出。经过三个职业赛季，这位多米尼加共和国球员的三振率达到38.1%；问题在于21.4%的保送率。这使得他最近一次先发更加令人印象深刻，他投了五局无失分，仅被击出一支安打，没有送出保送。本赛季打者很难碰到他的任何球，他的速球、滑球和变速球被打率均低于.200，挥空率超过40%。
右投手：David Davalillo，Round Rock Express（三A）游骑兵第15号新秀。0-0，自责分率0.00，1场，1先发，6局，1安打，0失分，0自责分，0保送，7三振，WHIP 0.17。
Davalillo出身于棒球世家，以其丰富的球种和投球能力著称。周五他展示了这一点，他用五种不同球种三振了七名打者，并在无失分先发中仅让一名跑者上垒。这位25岁球员今年第二次投满六局，并且只用了76球。这位身高6英尺1英寸的右投手曾在2025年4月入选潜力新秀阵容，他拥有小联盟中最好的指叉球之一，这个球种初速在80英里/小时低位，对手对其打击率为.158，长打率为.211。
后援投手：Ty Johnson，Durham Bulls（三A）光芒第10号新秀。0-0，自责分率0.00，2场，3局，0安打，0失分，0自责分，0保送，6三振，WHIP 0.00。
在赛季前10次出场担任先发后，Johnson已转往后援——并在8月完全占据主导。这位身高6英尺6英寸的右投手在投球动作中利用大量欺骗性和延伸，凭借五五开的速球-滑球组合制造大量挥空。这位2023年15轮秀本月在5次出场中投了6局无失分，仅被击出一支安打、送出一次保送，同时有9次三振。如果他能开发出使用不多的变速球，或许能重回首发，但即使没有，他也有在后援中占据统治地位的条件。

items.titleEn: Do Blue Jays have real shot at Wild Card? 3 reasons why they just might
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- Which teams in the AL Wild Card race truly scare you?

The Tigers have played well, even after dealing ace Tarik Skubal to the Dodgers, and their +85 run differential sticks out in the sea of negative numbers. The Orioles have at least handled themselves well against teams with winning records. The Mariners, stuck in a disappointing season, have the rotation to make a run.
Should any of these teams truly scare the Blue Jays, though? Are any of them undeniable?
It certainly doesn’t feel like it, and until that changes, the red-hot Blue Jays might be the team everyone else in this race is keeping an eye on.
This is why they can pull it off:
1. The rotation isn’t just surviving, it’s thriving
Dylan Cease is going to be good, maybe even win the AL Cy Young Award. José Soriano is just fine, too. The Blue Jays would feel great about their one-two punch in a Wild Card Series or ALDS.

Beyond that, though, the Blue Jays are being saved by a rotation that has every excuse to be crumbling. Shane Bieber and Max Scherzer have held strong, and the Blue Jays even survived a bullpen day on Saturday, taking down Cam Schlittler and the Yankees by rolling out seven relievers.

Every button manager John Schneider presses is working right now. It still feels very dangerous to bet on this sustaining for the final six weeks of the season, especially considering the massive workload this bullpen has taken on, but it’s working for now.

Trey Yesavage just underwent left knee surgery to repair his meniscus, so if he can pull off a comeback late in the season, that would likely be in a shortened role. Spencer Arrighetti has a shot at returning much sooner, though, after pitching Sunday in a Triple-A Buffalo rehab outing. That would give the Blue Jays a legitimate No. 5, and if he could give them something in the range of his career 4.66 ERA with stable innings, that’s more than enough.
2. A soft, soft schedule

Pointing to other teams’ weaknesses doesn’t feel like the most inspiring argument for the Blue Jays, but isn’t this what the Wild Card race is all about right now? Sure, they’re playing their best baseball of 2026, but we’re still talking about a team with a losing record. They’re in this race because the rest of the American League is weak in the middle.

After playing the Rays and Yankees on the road this week, the Blue Jays roll right into a dream ending for their final 30 games. They’ll close out with series against: Royals, Mariners, Guardians, Royals, A’s, Orioles, Tigers, Rangers, Orioles and Reds.

None of those teams have a winning record. Of course, this needs to come with the disclaimer that any team can beat any other club in the big leagues, but let’s not kid ourselves. If you’re in a postseason race, this is the schedule you want.
3. The offense can’t get any worse

This is another one of those points that doesn’t feel terribly inspiring, but there’s something to it. Schneider kept coming back to the “law of averages” around the All-Star break, firmly believing that the Blue Jays’ best baseball was ahead of them because they were getting their bad baseball out of the way early.
Well, it’s averaging out, isn’t it?

Only the Mariners have scored fewer runs than the Blue Jays across MLB, and frankly, their recent run hasn’t been much more encouraging on offense. Perhaps the Blue Jays can ride this scrappy brand of small ball into the postseason, but eventually, they’ll need to expand their brand beyond hitting singles.

“I think there needs to be a little bit more of a blend of extra-base hits there,” Schneider said. “That's been a big difference. I don't want to compare last year to this year, but it's been a big difference to where you can generate some offense quickly. Singles are great when they're coupled with some doubles or homers.”

That’s the beauty in how low the bar is right now. The Blue Jays don’t need to turn into the 1927 Yankees overnight, they just need to turn into an average offensive ballclub. They don’t need Vladimir Guerrero Jr. to turn into Aaron Judge when he eventually returns from the seven-day concussion IL, they just need an OPS over .800 down the stretch with a few homers. This should be doable, and if the Blue Jays can pair that with this level of pitching and some tight defense, anything is possible.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟冲击外卡有戏吗？三大理由显示有机会
items.summaryZh: 美联外卡形势混乱，蓝鸟凭借出色轮值、轻松赛程和进攻回升，有机会闯入季后赛。
bodyZh: 本文摘自 Keegan Matheson 的 Blue Jays Beat 通讯。要阅读完整通讯，请点击此处。并订阅以定期在收件箱中收到。
多伦多——美联外卡争夺战中，有哪些球队真正让你感到威胁？
老虎队表现出色，即使将王牌投手 Tarik Skubal 交易到道奇之后依然如此。他们 +85 的净胜分在众多负值中格外突出。金莺队至少在面对胜率过半的球队时表现得当。水手队虽然本赛季令人失望，但他们有轮值可以发起冲击。
然而，这些球队中有哪支真正让蓝鸟队感到害怕吗？有哪支是无可争议的吗？
显然并非如此。在这种情况改变之前，状态火热的蓝鸟队可能正是这场争夺中其他球队都在关注的队伍。
这就是他们能做到的原因：
1. 先发轮值不只是扛住，更是强势发挥
Dylan Cease 会表现出色，甚至可能赢得美联赛扬奖。José Soriano 也相当不错。蓝鸟队对于在外卡系列赛或美联分区系列赛中拥有这样的前两号先发组合会感到非常满意。
但除此之外，蓝鸟队正被一套本有充分理由崩溃的先发轮值所拯救。Shane Bieber 和 Max Scherzer 依然表现坚强，蓝鸟队甚至在周六的牛棚日挺了过来，动用七名后援投手战胜了 Cam Schlittler 和洋基队。
主教练 John Schneider 现在做出的每个决定都奏效了。不过，想要指望这个状态在赛季最后六周延续下去，依然非常冒险，尤其是考虑到牛棚已经承担了巨大的工作量，但目前确实管用。
Trey Yesavage 刚刚接受左膝半月板修复手术，因此如果他能在赛季末复出，那也很可能是一个缩短的角色。不过 Spencer Arrighetti 有机会更早回来，他周日在 3A 水牛城打了一场复健赛。那将给蓝鸟队一个真正的五号先发；如果他能投出接近生涯 4.66 自责分率的稳定局数，那就绰绰有余了。
2. 非常轻松的赛程
指出其他球队的弱点，对于蓝鸟队来说并不算最鼓舞人心的论据，但这难道不是目前外卡争夺战的意义所在吗？诚然，他们打出了2026赛季最好的棒球，但说的还是一支战绩欠佳的球队。他们能进入争夺，是因为美国联盟中游实力太弱。
在客场打完光芒队和洋基队之后，蓝鸟队将迎来赛季最后30场的梦幻收官。他们将以系列赛结束剩余赛程，对手依次是：皇家、水手、守护者、皇家、运动家、金莺、老虎、游骑兵、金莺和红人。
这些球队中没有一支战绩胜率过半。当然，这句话需要附带一个免责声明：大联盟中任何一支球队都可能击败另一支球队，但我们别自欺欺人了。如果你正在打季后赛争夺战，这就是你想要的赛程。
3. 进攻已经不能再糟了
这是另一个感觉不太振奋的理由，但也有它的道理。Schneider 在全明星周前后一直提到“平均律”，他坚信蓝鸟队最好的棒球在前面等待，因为他们已经早早把糟糕的表现打出去了。
嗯，现在正在回归平均，不是吗？
在大联盟中，只有水手队的得分比蓝鸟队少。坦率说，他们最近的进攻端也没太多鼓舞人心的东西。也许蓝鸟队可以凭这种顽强的小球打法闯入季后赛，但最终，他们需要将进攻方式拓展到单打安打之外。
“我认为需要多一些长打的结合，”Schneider 说道，“这是一个巨大的不同。我不想拿去年和今年作比较，但在快速创造得分方面确实存在巨大差异。单打如果配合一些二垒安打或本垒打，那很棒。”
这就是眼下门槛低到这种程度的美妙之处。蓝鸟队不需要一夜之间变成1927年的洋基队，他们只需要变成一支进攻平均水准的球队。Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 最终从七天脑震荡伤病名单回归后，也不需要变成 Aaron Judge，只需要在最后阶段打出超过 .800 的 OPS 并贡献几个本垒打就够了。这应该能做到，如果蓝鸟队能将其与现有投球水准和严密防守结合起来，一切皆有可能。

items.titleEn: Big picture for Blue Jays: Loss just a blip in momentum-changing run
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays nearly pulled off another stunner in Sunday’s finale in the Yankees, but another series win over an AL East rival will have to do.

The 4-3 loss in 10 innings finally got a jolt of late life when the Blue Jays scraped across the game-tying run in the bottom of the ninth with a little help from a Ben Rice error. But Rice quickly made up for that by launching a two-run shot off Braydon Fisher in extras.
Now, the Blue Jays drop to one game back of the Orioles and the Rangers, who play Sunday night, in the tight AL Wild Card race.
This is what mattered most from Sunday’s finale:

1. No sweep, but another series winJust like their recent four-game series against the Red Sox, the Blue Jays fell one win short of the sweep. But series wins are going to be their ticket to the postseason if they keep playing like this.

Inside the Blue Jays’ clubhouse, you’d be surprised at just how well players and coaches are able to compartmentalize from day to day. They’re certainly aware of the standings, but they might not be checking the standings tab on the MLB App as often as Toronto fans are. It’s one game at a time and one series at a time, which is serving them well recently.

Now comes the biggest challenge left on their schedule, a three-gamer against the Rays at Tropicana Field beginning Tuesday before they travel to Yankee Stadium for three more against the Yankees. This is the Blue Jays’ shot to set themselves up for their final 30 games, a stretch during which they don’t face a single team with a current winning record.
2. Cy Young watch: Cease lands the counterpunchOne day after Cam Schlittler held the Blue Jays to one run over 5 1/3 innings, Dylan Cease answered back with something even better.

Cease held the Yankees to two runs on just two hits over 6 1/3 innings, racking up another 10 strikeouts. The second run scored with Brendon Little on the mound, after Cease had departed. This performance nudged Cease’s ERA up to 2.42, continuing what’s on track to be one of the greatest single-season pitching performances in Blue Jays history.

The race between Cease and Schlittler is fascinating. Schlittler’s 2.19 ERA over more innings (152) than Cease (137 2/3) gives him a strong case, but so does Cease’s strikeout total (201). In such a tight race, every inning is going to matter down the stretch, with one ugly start on either side of this race having the potential to flip it completely.

Cease’s ninth strikeout of the night, to end the sixth inning, was also his 200th of the season. This is the sixth consecutive season in which Cease has struck out 200 batters, and doing it on Aug. 16 after missing two starts for a brief IL stint earlier in the season is absurd. Only the strikeout king Jacob Misiorowski of the Brewers has more (210).
Those six consecutive seasons are a true accomplishment, too. Only five pitchers in MLB history have longer streaks:
Tom Seaver (9): 1968-76Max Scherzer (8): 2012-19Chris Sale (7): 2013-19Roger Clemens (7): 1986-92Walter Johnson (7): 1910-16

3. The next step? Stealing games with powerThe Blue Jays aren’t about to hit 14 home runs over three games against the Rays, but there’s still room for a realistic uptick here. Charles McAdoo’s RBI double from Saturday’s win is a great example, anything to give the Blue Jays a boost of energy and shake up the march of singles.

If the Blue Jays are going to play all of these 2-1 and 3-2 ballgames down the stretch, that’s just fine. Perhaps they can scrape out more wins than losses, but along the way, they’ll need to steal a game or two. Right now, Toronto ranks 29th in home runs (116).
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟大局：失利只是势头转变中的小插曲
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟加时惜败洋基，仍赢下系列赛；赛扬奖竞争白热化，本垒打排名第29位。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟在周日与洋基的系列赛收官战中险些再次上演逆转好戏，但最终只能满足于又一次击败美联东区对手并赢下系列赛。
这场以4-3告负的十局大战在末段突然迎来生机，蓝鸟在九局下半靠着Ben Rice的失误勉强跑回追平分。但Rice迅速将功补过，在延长局从Braydon Fisher手中轰出两分炮。
如今，蓝鸟在胶着的美联外卡争夺战中落后金莺和游骑兵一场胜差，这两队将在周日夜赛交手。
这是周日收官战最重要的几点：
1. 未能横扫，但再次赢下系列赛 与最近对红袜的四场系列赛一样，蓝鸟只差一胜便能横扫。但如果能保持这样的表现，系列赛胜利将为他们敲开季后赛大门。
在蓝鸟更衣室里，你会惊讶于球员和教练们能如此专注当下。他们当然清楚排名，但或许不会像多伦多球迷那样频繁查看MLB App的积分榜。他们一场一场地拼、一个系列赛一个系列赛地打，这套应对方式近来效果颇佳。
接下来是他们剩余赛程中最大的考验：周二起在Tropicana Field与光芒进行三场系列赛，之后前往洋基球场再战洋基三场。这是蓝鸟为最后30场比赛奠定基础的机会，那段赛程中他们将不会面对任何一支当前胜率过半的球队。
2. 赛扬奖观察：Cease还以颜色 就在Cam Schlittler先发5 1/3局仅让蓝鸟得到一分后的第二天，Dylan Cease用更出色的表现做出回应。
Cease在对洋基的6 1/3局中仅被击出2支安打，失掉2分，并再次送出10次三振。第二分是在Cease退场后，由Brendon Little在投手丘上丢掉。这场表现让Cease的自责分率微升至2.42，延续了他有望缔造蓝鸟史上最伟大单季投球表现之一的势头。
Cease与Schlittler的赛扬奖竞争十分有趣。Schlittler的自责分率2.19，投球局数（152局）也比Cease（137 2/3局）更多，这让他很有说服力；但Cease的三振数（201）同样极具竞争力。在如此胶着的竞争中，赛季末段的每一局都将至关重要，任何一方一场糟糕的先发都可能完全改变局势。
Cease当晚的第九次三振出现在第六局结束时，同时也是他本赛季的第200次三振。这是他连续第六个赛季三振数达到200，而且在赛季初因短暂进入伤病名单缺席两场先发后，还能在8月16日达成这一纪录，简直不可思议。目前只有酿酒人的三振王Jacob Misiorowski比他更多（210次）。
这连续六个赛季同样是一项真正的成就。在MLB历史上，只有五位投手拥有更长的连续赛季纪录：
Tom Seaver (9): 1968-76 Max Scherzer (8): 2012-19 Chris Sale (7): 2013-19 Roger Clemens (7): 1986-92 Walter Johnson (7): 1910-16
3. 下一步？用力量偷走比赛 蓝鸟不会在对光芒的三场系列赛中轰出14记本垒打，但仍有现实的提升空间。Charles McAdoo在周六获胜中的打点二垒安打就是一个好例子，任何能为蓝鸟注入活力、打破单打节奏的进攻方式都值得采用。
如果蓝鸟在赛季末段要打这些2-1、3-2的比赛，那也没关系。他们也许能勉强多赢几场，但过程中也得偷走一两场胜利。眼下，多伦多以116记本垒打排名大联盟第29位。

items.titleEn: Card collecting both a 'hobby and semi-obsession' for Straw
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Myles Straw is not just a card collector, he is a connoisseur.

To a fellow collector, the shelves of his locker are like wings of an art museum. He might pull a baseball card out of his pocket and hand it to you, all too casually, before you realize that it’s worth twice the value of your car.

Straw calls this a “hobby and semi-obsession,” but card collectors share a language. We know there’s nothing “semi” obsessive about this. There’s always another grail, another 1-of-1 to chase -- but that’s not where the roots of this live. Straw, like so many of us who have come back to card collecting decades later, still remembers that first feeling. He was just a boy in Florida who wanted a Pokemon card.

“I remember being with my dad,” Straw said. “I’ll never forget going to the flea market back where I lived, and my dad bought me a Charizard. I can’t remember if it was a first edition, but now I have no idea where it’s at. Like a lot of us who used to do the same thing, we have no clue where it is now. My dad passed, but I always remember that moment with him.”

That connection to the childhood hobby is so important, even as the card industry has skyrocketed and turned into a cardboard stock market. It started with Straw and a small circle of teammates in the Blue Jays clubhouse one year ago, but now they’ve all got that bug again.

Card collectors will ask one another: “Who do you PC?” -- meaning your personal collection. Some of these are investments for Straw, bought one day and flipped weeks later for serious profits. But others are worth holding onto.

“I try to collect the GOATs of all sports, really. I even have a couple of hockey cards,” Straw said. “I mainly like to stay with baseball. I still have a lot of Pokemon cards, too. I love Tom Brady. I’m a Bucs fan and he came and won the Super Bowl for us, so I love Tom Brady and have a lot of his cards. Then, obviously, a lot of people will hate to hear this … but Shohei Ohtani.”
Straw’s Ohtani collection is stunning.

Sitting side-by-side, he has a pair of autographed Shohei Ohtani rookie cards from the 2018 Topps Chrome set, one a blue wave refractor and the other in brilliant gold, each graded as a PSA Gem Mint 10. There’s a signed Ohtani atomic refractor, numbered to 100, from the 2018 Bowman set, graded a 9.5 Gem Mint by Beckett. These are, in plain English, rare and pristine Ohtani cards, the value of which would have your jaw on the floor.
There are two centerpieces to Straw’s Ohtani collection, though, one for its value and the other for its story.

Straw owns the 1-of-1 signed Ohtani card from the 2025 Topps Chrome Black collection, the “superfractor” and only one of its kind. Any superfractor is extremely valuable, but Ohtani’s sell well into the hundreds of thousands. Just last year, one of Ohtani’s most sought-after superfractors from 2018 Topps Chrome sold for $2.5 million.

The other star of the collection is from the 2025 Topps Diamond Icons set, another Ohtani numbered to just 15 in circulation. Straw pulled that card from a pack himself early in 2025 -- and during a quiet moment of last year’s World Series, Straw sent it over to be signed by Ohtani himself. What a card, what a story.
“I will never sell that card,” Straw said.

Even for the heavy hitters in card collecting -- and Straw is certainly one -- the story still matters. Straw has started to collect his teammates over the years, and now owns Dylan Cease’s rookie superfractor 1-of-1, one of Cease’s most valuable cards in circulation.

Collectors are always looking to rope a new friend into the obsession, too, and who better than Cease? The Blue Jays’ ace already has that bug, his latest fixation being rare vintage T-shirts, and calls collecting “the innate desire to expand” oneself. If Straw gets his way, Cease’s locker will be stuffed with cards and eBay packages soon enough.
“He’s always like, ‘I need to buy me a grail,’” Straw said, doing a big, deep voice to impersonate Cease. “And I’m like, 'Cease, you have so much money. You can buy whatever you want.'”
Another of Straw’s gems -- and one he’ll never sell -- is a Kazuma Okamoto card that is already one of the most valuable in existence and certainly the most unique.

This is an “anime” card from the 2026 Bowman set, a rare “short print” variation of Okamoto’s rookie card that is already extremely valuable on its own. Straw found one of the red-bordered versions of this card, numbered to just five in circulation, but then took it a step further. Teammates are always having one another sign cards, but Straw had Okamoto grace this card with a kanji autograph in matching red ink. It is, in every possible way, an exquisite baseball card.

Everyone has their limits and budgets, but again, there’s always that next grail to chase. Smart collectors will get their partners in on the hobby with them, and while Straw has tried to get his wife, Lily, to open some packs with him and his friends, he’s fallen into the same trap that so many of us do.
“She told me to stop months ago, but the packages keep arriving,” Straw said.

These are just cardboard rectangles, though, 2 1/2 inches by 3 1/2 inches. There’s a reason these cards drive us mad -- or to the point of mild obsession, as Straw says -- and that’s because of the stories they carry. Those stories can connect seasons of your life, from a kid at the flea market to a big leaguer, or even generations.
Straw still remembers that Charizard from 25 years ago. The card is long gone, but that card had a story, and a memory with his father, James.
“I have a lot of my own cards, just for my girls,” Straw said. “When they’re older, hopefully they think their dad is cool. I can give them some evidence that I was semi-relevant.”
items.titleZh: Straw：集卡既是爱好也是“半痴迷”
items.summaryZh: Straw将卡片收藏视为“爱好和半痴迷”，他拥有Ohtani等多位球星的珍稀卡片，并珍藏与父亲的集卡回忆。
bodyZh: 多伦多——Myles Straw不仅是一名卡片收藏家，还是一位鉴赏家。
对同为收藏者的人来说，他储物柜里的隔层就像艺术博物馆的展厅。他可能会漫不经心从口袋里掏出一张棒球卡递给你，等你意识到它的价值是你汽车的两倍时，为时已晚。
Straw称这是“爱好和半痴迷”，但卡片收藏者之间有共同语言。我们知道这绝不只是“半”痴迷。总会有另一个圣杯、另一张1-of-1要去追寻——但那不是这一切的根源。Straw和我们中许多在数十年后重新拾起卡片收藏的人一样，仍然记得最初的感觉。他当时只是佛罗里达州一个想要宝可梦卡的小男孩。
“我记得和爸爸在一起的时候，”Straw说，“我永远不会忘记我们去我住的地方附近的跳蚤市场，爸爸给我买了一张喷火龙。我不记得它是不是第一版，但现在我不知道它在哪里。像我们许多曾经这样做过的人一样，我们不知道它现在在哪儿。我爸爸已经去世了，但我永远记得和他在一起的那个时刻。”
这种与童年爱好的联系非常重要，即使卡片行业已经飞速发展，变成了纸板股票市场。一年前，这股收藏热从Straw和蓝鸟俱乐部的一小群队友开始，现在他们都再次迷上了它。
卡片收藏者会互相问：“你PC谁？”——指的是你的个人收藏。其中一些对Straw来说是投资，某天买入，几周后转手获得可观利润。但另一些则值得保留。
“我试着收藏所有运动项目的GOAT，真的。我甚至有几张冰球卡，”Straw说，“我主要喜欢棒球。我也还有很多宝可梦卡。我爱Tom Brady。我是海盗队球迷，他为我们赢得了超级碗，所以我很爱Tom Brady，有很多他的卡。然后，显然，很多人会不喜欢听这个……但还有Shohei Ohtani。”
Straw的Ohtani收藏令人惊叹。
并排摆放着两张2018 Topps Chrome系列的Shohei Ohtani亲签新秀卡，一张是蓝波折射卡，另一张是亮金色，每张都被评为PSA Gem Mint 10。还有一张2018 Bowman系列的Ohtani亲签原子折射卡，限量100张，被Beckett评为9.5 Gem Mint。简单说，这些是罕见且品相完美的Ohtani卡，其价值会让你目瞪口呆。
不过，Straw的Ohtani收藏中有两件核心藏品，一件因其价值，另一件因其故事。
Straw拥有一张来自2025 Topps Chrome Black系列的唯一签名Ohtani卡，即“超级折射”卡，仅此一张。任何超级折射卡都极其昂贵，而Ohtani的可以卖到数十万美元。就在去年，一张Ohtani最受追捧的2018 Topps Chrome超级折射卡以250万美元的价格售出。
收藏中的另一颗明星来自2025 Topps Diamond Icons系列，另一张Ohtani卡仅限量15张。Straw在2025年初亲自从一包卡中抽出这张卡——在去年世界大赛的一个安静时刻，Straw把它寄给Ohtani本人签名。多么棒的一张卡，多么棒的故事。
“我永远不会卖掉那张卡，”Straw说。
即使对于卡片收藏中的重量级人物——Straw当然是其中之一——故事仍然很重要。多年来，Straw开始收藏队友的卡片，现在他拥有一张Dylan Cease的新秀超级折射1-of-1，这是Cease流通中最有价值的卡片之一。
收藏者总是想拉一个新朋友入坑，还有谁比Cease更合适呢？蓝鸟的王牌已经有了那种热情，他最近迷上的是罕见的复古T恤，并称收藏是“人与生俱来的扩展欲望”。如果Straw如愿，Cease的储物柜很快就会塞满卡片和eBay包裹。
“他总是说，‘我得给自己买个圣杯，’”Straw用低沉的声音模仿Cease说，“我就说，‘Cease，你那么多钱，想买什么都能买。’”
Straw的另一件珍品——也是他永远不会卖的一件——是一张Kazuma Okamoto卡，这已经是现存最有价值的卡之一，而且绝对是最独特的。
这是2026 Bowman系列中的一张“动漫”卡，是Okamoto新秀卡的罕见“短印”变体，本身就已经极其珍贵。Straw找到了这张卡的红边版本，仅限量5张，但他更进一步。队友们总是互相在卡片上签名，但Straw让Okamoto用匹配的红色墨水在这张卡片上签下汉字签名。无论在哪个方面，这都是一张精美的棒球卡。
每个人都有各自的限额和预算，但同样，总有一个下一个圣杯值得去追。聪明的收藏者会让伴侣一起参与这项爱好，虽然Straw曾试图让妻子Lily和他及朋友们一起拆卡包，但他也落入了我们许多人都陷入的陷阱。
“她几个月前就让我停手，但包裹还是不断送来，”Straw说。
不过，这些只是纸板长方形，2.5英寸乘3.5英寸。这些卡片让我们疯狂（或者如Straw所说，达到轻度痴迷的程度）是有原因的——因为它们承载着故事。那些故事可以连接你生命中的各个阶段，从跳蚤市场的孩子到大联盟球员，甚至跨越几代人。
Straw仍然记得25年前的那张喷火龙。那张卡早已不见踪影，但那张卡有一个故事，还有与他父亲James的一段回忆。
“我有很多自己的卡，是留给我的女儿们的，”Straw说，“等她们长大了，希望她们觉得自己的爸爸很酷。我可以给她们一些证据，证明我当时还算有点分量。”
